def: properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown)
kjv: make princes, have power, reign. See H5493 (סוּר).

words.word: but not by me they have made princes

occurrences.text: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
words: but not by me they have made princes
